'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Cuong Nguyen DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cuong Nguyen]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
* '''Username:''' OmegaXen
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
